row.title: A conflict label is a past reading; read live mergeability before closing (PR-BOUND-3)
row.body: prbound closed #2615 twice on a conflict label set at 02:50 while the branch merged cleanly with main, once 11 seconds after a reopen. The closer now reads GitHub's live mergeable state, drops a stale label and waits on an unknown state.
